tasks.short: Compute and record justified welding machine settings for new work

steps.what: Check the new work's material properties, joint requirements, machine capabilities and applicable approved process instructions
inputs: engineering-issued work specification with material, dimensions, joint and revision
process-owner approved instructions and machine parameter limits

steps.what: Apply knowledge of metal properties and welding principles to select the applicable process basis and enter explicit calculation assumptions
outputs: setter-entered applicable calculation rule, input values and units

steps.what: Compute settings for the new work using shop mathematics and place the calculated values in the draft setting record
inputs: setter-entered applicable calculation rule, input values and units
outputs: calculated draft setting values with input and rule references

steps.what: Assess calculated settings for plausibility, process applicability and limits, leaving unsupported cases unresolved
inputs: calculated draft setting values with input and rule references
outputs: setter-reviewed calculated settings and explicit unresolved exceptions

steps.what: Complete the new-work setting record with actual assumptions, rationale and unresolved restrictions
inputs: setter-reviewed calculated settings and explicit unresolved exceptions
setter-entered applicable calculation rule, input values and units

steps.what: Check and approve the exact final computed-setting record within the setter's authority
Save the approved computed settings in the same new-work record without writing machine controls
outputs: stored new-work computed settings and restrictions

tasks.design: Configure the {OPS_SYSTEM} setting worksheet with process-owner approved formulas and limits linked to the current {DOCS} instructions. The setter chooses the applicable basis and enters actual inputs, checks the calculated values and completes the rationale before approving and saving the setting record; no machine-control write occurs.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated instruction lookup and arithmetic can sit beside skilled judgement about which process assumptions apply.
tasks.enabler_now: Native calculation fields and validated units can reproduce approved shop mathematics without a model loop.
tasks.still_hard: A formula cannot establish that a new material, joint or process lies within its validated scope.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an inapplicable rule and leave a setting unresolved rather than trusting a plausible number.

ambition.what: Compare two authorised parameter scenarios for new work before choosing a trial basis.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-5 for work and process-rule access; consult setters and process owners about changed recording

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: configurable operational worksheets can calculate explicit numeric settings from approved formulas and retain their input and rule references.

assumptions: Boundary is computing and recording settings for new work, including their assumptions and review. Physical machine setup, qualification trials and production release are separate tasks and earn no claimed saving here.

Engineering supplies work id, revision, material and dimensions; process owners supply applicable rule id, version, units and limits. s1 checks references and s2 retains all judgement and manual capture of calculation inputs; no free extraction or new recipe is assumed.

Native configuration first. Only calculations within an approved scope can use s3; missing or unsuitable rules return to manual work and process-owner clarification. No model invents welding parameters or acts as a machine safety function.

The provisional scenario is an existing operational setting record with repeated lookup and manual arithmetic; it does not assert a measured paper, spreadsheet or rekey baseline. If native formulas already cover the work, the gain is zero.

s3 creates draft calculated fields; s5 counts actual rationale and exception capture. Same-system save is approximately zero effort today and remains fully retained. No send or automatic controller load is hidden in the design.
All shares and retained percentages are unmeasured design scenarios; system runtime and physical work are not counted as removed labour.
unknowns: Availability of validated process-specific calculation rules
Actual installed worksheet and existing automation
Who may approve a computed-setting record versus a production release
research_questions: Can the worksheet reproduce a reviewed past computation with exact units and rule version?
Does it refuse an out-of-scope input rather than extrapolate?
How much human lookup and arithmetic remains after native configuration?

already_counted.description: Check calculated values, units and source-rule references

incremental.description: Maintain validated formula mappings and recheck them when process instructions change

approvals.approved_version: approved computed-setting record v1 including assumptions and restrictions; edits require s6 again

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central gross 23.5 minus 1 upkeep gives 22.5. High allows 5.5 extra hours resolving rule and unit exceptions; low applies when formulas already exist or new work is outside their scope.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The setter can spend less time finding instructions and performing repeat arithmetic while retaining process judgement, assumptions and approval of the recorded settings.
skills_to_grow: Validate input units and rule applicability
Trace computed settings to approved instructions
role.ambitious_version: Compare authorised setting scenarios with clear assumptions before any separately controlled physical trial or machine setup.

job.title: Welding, Soldering, and Brazing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
